drhp.business: EQUIPPP brings together digital platforms, social-tech professionals and an impact assessment marketplace to design, finance, implement and measure high-impact initiatives. The business spans two main verticals: IP and Impact Solutions (bookbuilding tools, Social Tech Professionals and an Impact Assessment Marketplace serving local governments, lawmakers, CSR agencies, impact funds, non-profits and the Social Stock Exchange) and IT and IT Staffing (IT staffing and workforce solutions for GCCs and MNCs). Other business verticals are under development.
drhp.end_markets: local governments and lawmakers|CSR agencies|impact funds and non-profits|Social Stock Exchange ecosystem|GCCs and MNCs (IT staffing)
drhp.expansion: EQUIPPP has expanded through subsidiary and stake acquisitions rather than physical capacity build-out: incorporation of wholly owned subsidiary P4 Goods and Services Private Limited to expand the Public-Private-People Partnership (P4) ecosystem; acquisition/subscription of 65% equity in Equippp Inc (US) to advance IP-led and IT services in global markets; and Board approval (May 30, 2025) of a MOU to acquire 51% of SMAAX Digitech India Private Limited with an infusion of Rs. 15 Crores to consolidate ownership across media IPs including SIIMA, CCL, INCA and Streaming Academy Awards. Other business verticals are stated to be under development.

litigation.note: The Company is contesting NSE's position that Corporate Governance (LODR) provisions apply to it despite net worth below Rs. 25 crore, per the Corporate Governance Report (Annexure F).

risks.note: The Company operates in a rapidly evolving technology environment where changing customer requirements and the pace of technological change present ongoing challenges to sustainable growth.
Management flags data security and regulatory compliance as ongoing challenges alongside talent availability, requiring continuous innovation and responsible technology practices.

Talent availability is flagged as an ongoing challenge; the Company's HR framework is built to attract, empower and retain top talent, indicating dependence on a small workforce (14 permanent employees standalone, 240 consolidated).

Technology consumption patterns vary across periods due to economic conditions, the regulatory/policy environment, geopolitical developments and pace of technological innovation, which can present both challenges and opportunities for the Company.

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- India's technology industry is expected to have crossed USD 315 billion in revenue in FY26; overall enterprise technology expenditure is expected to grow approximately 5-7% YoY in FY27, with spending composition shifting toward AI, digital engineering, cloud, data, cybersecurity and enterprise modernisation.
- Artificial Intelligence (including Agentic AI) is expected to be a defining FY27 theme, driving sustained demand for consulting, engineering, integration and managed services.
- The social impact ecosystem (nonprofits, foundations, development organisations) is increasingly adopting technology for programme delivery, beneficiary engagement, impact measurement, transparency and operational efficiency, creating demand for customised, sector-specific solutions.
- In May 2026 the Ministry of Corporate Affairs amended the CSR framework (G.S.R. 415(E) and 416(E)) to recognise subscription to zero coupon zero principal instruments on the Social Stock Exchange as a permissible CSR activity (capped at 10% of a company's total CSR expenditure), which management expects to give further impetus to the SSE and create an additional structured avenue for CSR capital deployment.
- The IP and Impact Solutions vertical is witnessing significant traction with a strong and growing pipeline of opportunities, supported by legislative developments; the IT and IT Staffing vertical has delivered steady numbers and results.
- Management flags that changing customer requirements, data security, regulatory compliance, talent availability and pace of technological change present ongoing challenges to sustainable growth.
- The IP and Impact Solutions vertical is witnessing significant traction, with a strong and growing pipeline of opportunities emerging.

capex_expansion.title: Expansion (RHP)
capex_expansion.body: EQUIPPP has expanded through subsidiary and stake acquisitions rather than physical capacity build-out: incorporation of wholly owned subsidiary P4 Goods and Services Private Limited to expand the Public-Private-People Partnership (P4) ecosystem; acquisition/subscription of 65% equity in Equippp Inc (US) to advance IP-led and IT services in global markets; and Board approval (May 30, 2025) of a MOU to acquire 51% of SMAAX Digitech India Private Limited with an infusion of Rs. 15 Crores to consolidate ownership across media IPs including SIIMA, CCL, INCA and Streaming Academy Awards. Other business verticals are stated to be under development.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The Company operates in a rapidly evolving technology environment where changing customer requirements and the pace of technological change present ongoing challenges to sustainable growth.
- Management flags data security and regulatory compliance as ongoing challenges alongside talent availability, requiring continuous innovation and responsible technology practices.
- Talent availability is flagged as an ongoing challenge; the Company's HR framework is built to attract, empower and retain top talent, indicating dependence on a small workforce (14 permanent employees standalone, 240 consolidated).
- Technology consumption patterns vary across periods due to economic conditions, the regulatory/policy environment, geopolitical developments and pace of technological innovation, which can present both challenges and opportunities for the Company.
- A meaningful part of EQUIPPP's opportunity set (SSE-linked CSR instruments, digital platforms for NPOs) depends on continuing legislative and policy support, such as the May 2026 CSR framework amendment; a reversal or slowdown in this policy support is a structural risk to the pipeline.
- Other business verticals are stated to be under development and expected to deliver results only in the near future; EQUIPPP Inc (US) and EQUIPPP SGIT JV LLP are both stated to be yet to commence business operations, indicating execution risk in scaling new lines.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- EQUIPPP is built on two strong verticals: IP and Impact Solutions (bookbuilding tools, Social Tech Professionals, Impact Assessment Marketplace serving local governments, lawmakers, CSR agencies, impact funds, non-profits and the Social Stock Exchange) and IT and IT Staffing (IT staffing and workforce solutions for GCCs and MNCs); other verticals are under development.
- The Company's focus on combining technology, domain understanding and outcome-oriented solutions is intended to position it to participate in the emerging social-impact technology market.
- EQUIPPP intends to expand its technology-enabled solutions for the Social Stock Exchange (SSE) ecosystem, including digital platforms and services for NPO onboarding, project discovery, fundraising management, impact measurement, reporting and stakeholder engagement.
